name: GoPray
author: Kim Gow

sections.description:
Prayer request application to users to submit requests, or pray for existing requests. All requests can be moderated from the admin section. Every time a request is submitted, prayer requester will receive an email.

Live GoPray

View our working version of GoPray, post a prayer request or pray for others here: Request Prayer

Features

  • List of prayer requests with details at administrator area
  • Email notifications to users and administrator when request is made
  • Easy management of content used in email notification
  • Enter comments for posted Prayer request
  • Customize button color to match website theme
  • Filter out unwanted prayer submissions/reply comments
  • Prayer form rely on reCAPTCHA, a free service from Google that helps protect websites from spam and abuse. See https://www.google.com/recaptcha and https://policies.google.com/terms
sections.installation:
1. Log in to your WordPress website dashboard
  2. Move to the Plugins section on the left navigation menu
  3. Click on the Add New button
  4. Enter GoPray in the search box
  5. Click on Install Now button
  6. Click on the Activate Now button
sections.faq:
What versions of Google reCAPTCHA does the plugin support?

Supports both the checkbox for the 2nd version and version 3

Can I send emails in plugin using a SMTP Mail plugin?

Yes, instead of using the default mail function, you can send emails via an SMTP plugin in WordPress. You can use Gmail, Yahoo, Hot mail’s, Mail Gun, Amazon SES, Sendgrid, Sendinblue, Outlook & Zoho Mail SMTP servers if you have an account with them

Is it possible to restore the deleted requests/comments?

If you choose the option “Move to trash” then you can find them from trash. But if you choose “Delete permanently”, then it is not possible to retrieve them
